# Rupkotha Travels (রূপকথা ট্রাভেলস)

> Rupkotha Travels is an experiential tour and travel operator based in Kolkata, West Bengal, and an official authorized booking agent for Eco Tour Odisha and Chhattisgarh Tourism. The agency specializes in escorted fixed group departures departing from Howrah and Sealdah railway stations with sleeper train tickets, verified hotel/camp stays, 4-course homely meals, dedicated mountain/forest vehicle fleets, and bespoke high-altitude Himalayan 4x4 road trips across India, Bhutan, and Nepal.

## Key Information & Core Services

- [Fixed Departures 2026–2027](/fixed-departures.md): All-inclusive escorted small group holiday packages departing from Kolkata (Howrah/Sealdah) to Rajasthan, Ladakh, Spiti, Tadoba, Bastar, Koraput, Sandakphu, North Bengal, Kaziranga, and Sikkim.
- [Destinations Directory](/destinations.md): Complete regional travel directory across 3 zones: Alpine Peaks (Ladakh, Spiti, Zanskar, Sandakphu, Sikkim), Wildlife Reserves (Tadoba, Kaziranga, Debrigarh, Satkosia, Sundarbans), and Heritage & Coastal circuits (Odisha, Bastar, Rajasthan, Andaman).
- [Tour Categories](/tour-categories.md): Three core travel styles: Type 1 (Fixed & Heritage Cultural Group Departures), Type 2 (High-Altitude Mountain 4x4 Expeditions), and Type 3 (Eco-Forest Safaris & Tropical Coasts).
- [Customizable Circuits](/customizable-circuits.md): Private bespoke holiday itineraries for Ladakh (LAD 01–08 with Pangong, Nubra, Tso Moriri, Siachen) and Andaman Islands (AND 01–05 with Port Blair, Havelock, Neil Island).
- [About & Official Credentials](/about.md): Agency heritage, official authorization certificates for Eco Tour Odisha and Chhattisgarh Tourism, dedicated vehicle fleet specifications, and Kolkata Lounge hub.
- [Package Policies & Inclusions](/policies.md): Transparent pricing breakdown, train ticket inclusions (Sleeper class from Sealdah/Howrah), 4-course daily meal plans, child fare rules, and tiered cancellation refund policies.
- [Booking Desk & Inquiries](/booking.md): Direct booking counter, reservation procedures, custom itinerary consultation, and WhatsApp concierge desk.

## Important Operational Policies

- **Train Journeys**: Fixed departures include confirmed Sleeper / Non-AC Chair Car train tickets from/to Howrah or Sealdah. 3AC upgrades available upon request.
- **Meal Policy**: 4 daily hot meals (Bed tea, breakfast, lunch, evening tea & snacks, dinner) with fresh local ingredients and Bengali/Indian preparation.
- **Safety & Altitude**: Himalayan expeditions include vehicle first-aid, pulse oximeter checks, staged acclimatization stops, and veteran local mountain drivers.
- **Official Counters**: Authorized booking agent for Odisha Eco-Tourism and Chhattisgarh Tourism Board nature camps.
